Replayable diagnostic case generator has visible skinned legs, rigid feet, near tube/tube_tip without a hand, skinned far arm/rigid claw and pelvis loincloth. Compiler, source/structure/bone gates and actual runtime pass.

Direct generator guards, held-item rename, IK regressions, independent bone gates, 777-file byte closure, fresh 1258-pose identity, requested focused/compatibility/runtime checks and ten mutations pass.
